status: Version2 lifted wrist and hatch visually accepted in two Prototype128 captures; continuous animation validation owned by Engineering
alpha: Native generated RGBA; preserve alpha. Optional alpha scissor .5 for solid edge, no dark background quad.
coordinates: All pivots/endpoints below are absolute atlas pixels, not crop-local. Subtract source_rect origin before UV/local conversion.

contact.scale_rule: uniform pixels-to-world from opaque width606px; do not stretch to140x200 legacy destination

curled.scale_rule: same uniform scale as contact (1.4/606 meter per pixel); no legacy50px vertical squash

assembly: Hatch is real wall-mounted geometry, not part of cutout atlas.
Anchor forearm root inside hatch and wrist at fist wrist. Extend wrist joint .06m behind fist to hide seam.
Scale arm along root-to-wrist axis only; keep thickness fixed. Orient cutout plane to camera while its endpoints remain world-registered.
Fist pivots at wrist; scale uniformly. Prefer forearm_a until both camera views validate alternate side. No abrupt view switching.
Drive whole limb in world space from root to wrist; depth-test against real wall/hatch. Forearm should emerge from opening, not lie over wall facade.
On impact lower contact knuckle extent to Y0; derive wrist height from transformed opaque bottom, do not place wrist atY0.
Retreat in world height/depth until opaque fist is above corridor; do not shrink lifted pose to fake clearance.
Keep moving hand visibility independent of permanent opening and use existing event times.
limitations: Two articulated planes cannot reveal a true back surface during arbitrary camera orbit. Scope limited to approved ±18-degree views.
Rendered camera pose, silhouette, wrist seam, contact and clearance must be verified in actual build.

joint_revision.reason: Forearm drawn end cap is visible when terminal lands at top-edge wrist pivot. Hide terminal inside opaque fist neck.
joint_revision.depth_order: Forearm behind fist at seam; do not move forearm camera-forward to cover cap. Depth-test both against world.
joint_revision.preserve: Existing fist wrist pivot, uniform scale and knuckle contact solver unchanged
joint_revision.root: Put forearm root end behind actual wall opening/frame so no root cut face is exposed outside hatch.
joint_revision.source_fix: Version2 removes painted oval cut faces from both forearm tips. Source hands had no matching oval; failed registration attempts alone did not remove forearm cap. Generated edit retains layout but is not pixel-identical.
